description: Start a stopped hosted app's container. Use to bring an app stopped via vibekit_stop_app back online.
name: vibekit_start_app

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Start confirmation and resulting container status.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Start App
